## Activity

During March 2024, East City Eye Clinic recorded 212 captures as part of routine site activity. The reported activity represents the work completed at the clinic during the month. Capture volumes are presented for operational monitoring and provide the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. No additional activity figures are reported in this summary.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Of the 212 captures, 3 were ungradable. This gives an ungradable rate of 1.4%. The result is recorded for ongoing quality monitoring and should be considered alongside the grading outcome. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 54 referable results from the captures completed at East City Eye Clinic. The median lag between capture and grading was 3 days. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during March 2024. The activity, image quality and grading figures are reported together to support routine review of site operations and service performance.
